title: Spent 4 days to make this paper-themed samurai fighting game!
author: Maasharu
selftext:
Playable now: [https://papercut.marz.gg/](https://papercut.marz.gg/)

Trailer (that Claude also made): [https://youtu.be/r3Cl7pQKJRY](https://youtu.be/r3Cl7pQKJRY)

Had a ton of fun working on this paper themed fighting game with Claude over the last few days!

Features:

* Guided tutorial
* Endless mode + leaderboard
* Ranked + leaderboard (and no players lmfao)
* Training mode + hitbox viewer

Still looking to playtest and polish further but it's been a hit so far within the friend group! Since it's brand new, there's not really a playerbase to go against yet. I encourage you to try playing with your friends, and I mean if there's enough interest I might organize a large playtesting block!

Let me know what yall think, and what to improve.

Claude Opus 5.5, Max 5 plan (juggling this and literally like 9 other projects)

Blender

Typescript + Three.js 

Hosting with Digital Ocean

Once I got the confirmation that it's actually a very fun game/experience I went all in and started an entire 10+ session workflow to get it Steam ready. Very fun process and very fun game so far!

GLHF!
